harnesses.list.description: Retrieves all registered harnesses with their current status and capabilities. Use this to discover available harnesses and their supported features before executing operations.

harnesses.get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific harness including its full capability manifest.

harnesses.register.description: Registers a new harness with the Open Harness system. Typically used by harness vendors or administrators to add support for a new agent harness.

harnesses.update.description: Updates configuration for an existing harness.

harnesses.unregister.description: Removes a harness from the registry. This does not uninstall the harness itself, only removes it from Open Harness management.

harnesses.capabilities.description: Retrieves the full capability manifest for a harness. Use this to determine which operations are supported before attempting them.

harnesses.health.description: Checks connectivity and health of a harness. Returns status information useful for monitoring and debugging.

harnesses.validateCredentials.description: Validates API credentials for a harness and optionally stores them for future use.

agents.list.description: Lists all agents deployed on a specific harness.

agents.create.description: Creates and deploys a new agent on the harness. The agent bundle includes the AGENTS.md manifest and any supporting files.

agents.get.description: Retrieves the current state and configuration of an agent.

agents.update.description: Updates agent configuration without redeploying the full bundle.

agents.delete.description: Removes an agent from the harness.

agents.clone.description: Creates a copy of an existing agent with a new name.

agents.export.description: Downloads the complete agent as an OAF package (.zip file), following the Open Agent Format specification.

agents.import.description: Imports an agent from an OAF package (.zip file) following the Open Agent Format specification.

skills.list.description: Lists all skills installed or registered on the harness.

skills.register.description: Registers or installs a skill on the harness. Skills consist of a SKILL.md manifest plus optional supporting files.

skills.get.description: Retrieves details about a specific skill.

skills.update.description: Updates skill metadata without uploading a new version.

skills.uninstall.description: Uninstalls or unregisters a skill from the harness.

skills.listVersions.description: Lists all available versions of a skill.

skills.rollback.description: Reverts a skill to a previous version.

skills.discover.description: Discovers skills available on the harness that are not yet registered. Useful for finding built-in or auto-detected skills.

skills.validate.description: Validates a skill bundle without installing it. Returns any errors or warnings.

skills.download.description: Downloads the complete skill bundle as a ZIP file.

skills.upgrade.description: Upgrades an existing skill to a new version.

mcp.list.description: Lists all MCP servers connected to the harness.

mcp.connect.description: Connects a new MCP server to the harness.

mcp.get.description: Retrieves details about a connected MCP server.

mcp.disconnect.description: Disconnects an MCP server from the harness.

mcp.listTools.description: Lists all tools provided by an MCP server.

mcp.listResources.description: Lists all resources provided by an MCP server.

mcp.listPrompts.description: Lists all prompts provided by an MCP server.

mcp.health.description: Checks the health and connectivity of an MCP server.

tools.list.description: Lists all available tools on the harness, including built-in tools, MCP tools, and skill-provided tools.

tools.get.description: Retrieves the schema and details for a specific tool.

tools.register.description: Registers a custom tool with the harness.

tools.unregister.description: Unregisters a custom tool from the harness.

tools.invoke.description: Directly invokes a tool outside of an execution context.

tools.invokeStream.description: Invokes a tool with streaming output. Useful for tools that produce incremental results.

execution.run.description: Executes a task on the harness. Returns immediately with an execution ID; use the stream endpoint to follow progress.

execution.stream.description: Executes a task with streaming response. Use this for real-time feedback during execution.

execution.list.description: Lists recent executions on the harness.

execution.get.description: Retrieves the current status and progress of an execution.

execution.attachStream.description: Attaches to an existing execution's event stream. Use `Last-Event-ID` header to resume from a specific point.

execution.result.description: Retrieves the final result of a completed execution.

execution.listArtifacts.description: Lists all artifacts generated by an execution.

execution.downloadArtifact.description: Downloads a specific artifact generated by an execution.

execution.listToolCalls.description: Lists all tool calls made during an execution with their inputs and outputs.

execution.sendInput.description: Sends input (stdin) to a running execution that is waiting for user input.

sessions.list.description: Lists all sessions on the harness.

sessions.end.description: Ends and optionally deletes a session.

sessions.history.description: Retrieves the message history for a session.

sessions.fork.description: Creates a copy of a session with its history, allowing experimentation from a specific point.

sessions.connect.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection for real-time interactive communication with a session.

sessions.sendMessage.description: Sends a message to a session and waits for the complete response. Use this for non-streaming interactions.

sessions.sendMessageStream.description: Sends a message to a session with streaming response.

memory.get.description: Retrieves the complete memory state for an agent.

memory.listBlocks.description: Lists all memory blocks for an agent.

memory.getBlock.description: Retrieves a specific memory block by label.

memory.updateBlock.description: Updates the value of a memory block.

memory.createBlock.description: Creates a new memory block for an agent.

memory.search.description: Searches across memory blocks and archive for relevant content.

memory.getArchive.description: Retrieves the archival/long-term memory for an agent.

memory.addToArchive.description: Adds an entry to the agent's archival memory.

memory.export.description: Exports the agent's complete memory state as a downloadable snapshot. This snapshot can be included in an OAF package when exporting an agent with `include_memory=true`.

memory.import.description: Imports a previously exported memory snapshot into an agent. Used for restoring memory state or transferring memory between agents.

subagents.list.description: Lists all subagents spawned by a parent agent.

subagents.spawn.description: Spawns a new subagent to handle a specific task in isolation.

subagents.get.description: Retrieves the current state of a subagent.

subagents.delegate.description: Delegates a task to a subagent and waits for completion.

subagents.delegateStream.description: Delegates a task to a subagent with streaming progress.

subagents.result.description: Retrieves the result of a completed subagent task.

subagents.attachStream.description: Attaches to a running subagent's execution stream.

files.list.description: Lists files in the harness workspace.

files.read.description: Reads the contents of a file.

files.write.description: Writes content to a file, creating it if it doesn't exist.

files.delete.description: Deletes a file or empty directory.

files.search.description: Searches for files using glob patterns or content grep.

files.upload.description: Uploads a single file to the workspace.

files.uploadBatch.description: Uploads multiple files preserving directory structure.

files.download.description: Downloads a file with Content-Disposition header for saving.

files.downloadBatch.description: Downloads multiple files as a ZIP archive.

files.mkdir.description: Creates a directory and any necessary parent directories.

hooks.list.description: Lists all registered hooks for a harness.

hooks.get.description: Retrieves details about a specific hook.

hooks.streamEvents.description: Subscribes to real-time events from the harness.

hooks.listEvents.description: Lists recent events from the harness.

webhooks.register.description: Registers a webhook endpoint to receive async notifications.

planning.get.description: Retrieves the current execution plan (todo list).

planning.update.description: Updates the execution plan, typically to add or reorder tasks.

planning.listTasks.description: Lists all tasks in the execution plan.

planning.updateTask.description: Updates a specific task's status or content.

planning.stream.description: Subscribes to real-time plan updates during execution.

conformance.run.description: Initiates a conformance test run against a harness.

conformance.stream.description: Streams real-time progress of conformance tests.

conformance.results.description: Retrieves results from conformance test runs.

conformance.status.description: Retrieves the current conformance certification status.

diagnostics.get.description: Retrieves diagnostic information about the harness.

diagnostics.logs.description: Retrieves recent logs from the harness.

diagnostics.streamLogs.description: Streams logs in real-time. Useful for debugging and monitoring.
